description: This PHP source file defines the class WrappedHttpHandler, which converts a generic HTTP handler into an AWS-specific command handler, managing request execution, response parsing, error handling, and optional statistics collection.

classes.name: WrappedHttpHandler
classes.description: A class that wraps a generic HTTP handler to conform to AWS SDK's command execution pattern, handling request invocation, response parsing, error handling, and optional transfer statistics collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WrappedHttpHandler with the HTTP handler, response parser, error parser, exception class, and stats collection flag.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the wrapped HTTP handler with a command and request, managing stats collection and response/error handling.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response into an AWS result object, including metadata such as status, headers, and transfer stats.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Converts an error rejection into an AWS exception, parsing error details from the response if available.
